svg.title: AlphaCode neural link brain
svg.desc: Ten numbered subsystems of AlphaCode drawn as brain regions: interfaces, agent loop, model providers, memory, tools, senses, swarm, safety, skills and Rust core.
svg.text: HOW A TERMINAL AGENT THINKS, ACTS AND REMEMBERS
Talk to it by terminal, CLI or GUI.
Plans, acts and checks its own work.
Free lane, or bring your own model.
Edit files, run commands, search the web.
Drives real browsers and desktop apps.
Splits big goals across parallel agents.
Stops risky actions before they happen.
Plug-in reflexes that extend the core.
9 SKILLS · MCP · HOOKS EXTEND THE LOOP · 10 RUST CORE SUPERVISES EVERYTHING · NUMBERED NODES MATCH THE CARDS
